rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM and TE details from this single image and likely misidentifies a small circular structure as a polar body.
Thoroughly integrates age, PCOS, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, first-cycle status, and sperm motility with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates broadly matching the favorable profile, though some quantitative adjustments and assumptions are somewhat speculative.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading and general IVF management, but recommendations such as routine metformin for implantation benefit, aspirin, PGT-A after one failure at age 26, and ERA are more controversial and not standard guideline-driven.
Provides clear practical steps for transfer management and future planning, though some suggested adjuncts are not strongly evidence-based for this specific case.
